description.narrative: 1.Business development knowledge and skills of the Priority Agriculture Value Chain Actors (PAVCAs) and Value Chain Organizations (VCO) enhanced 2.Marketed volumes of Priority Agriculture Value Chains (PAVCs) products increased 3.Resilience of Priority Agriculture Value Chains (PAVCs) businesses to environment and climate change enhanced 4.Agriculture business development policy and institutional environment for Priority Agriculture Value Chains strengthened.

Det övergripande målet med projektet är att bidra till jordbrukssektorns tillväxt genom antagandet av innovativa, kommersiellt orienterade och moderna jordbruks- och boskapsföretag för fattigdomsbekämpning och hållbar mat- och näringstrygghet.

The overall goal of the project is to contribute to agriculture sector growth through the adoption of innovative, commercially oriented, and modern agriculture and livestock enterprises for poverty reduction and sustainable food and nutrition security.

The KABDP programme was terminated during its inception phase, a period intended for foundational activities. Due to delays in the submission of the disbursement request, no funds had been transferred from Sida to the Government of Kenya at the time of termination.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
